messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: autoscaler error in azure-europe-north2 — high queue growth, failing scale-up (quota errors). Pager: <https://pager.redwood.example/1748123456|incident-1748123456>
Maya (oncall): saw the bot. taking lead. connecting to runbook now. allocating 2m
Maya (oncall): @Arjun you up? I can hand off if you want the bridge
Arjun (SRE): On it. joining bridge. preliminary: autoscaler logs show repeated Azure API returns 403 quotaExceeded for GPU attach. pool attach retries hitting backoff.
Arjun (SRE): paste logs: ```2026-03-17T09:41:10Z autoscaler: attach-instance failed: error: compute.instances.attachGpu: quotaExceeded (region: europe-north2) requestId=3f9a7c
2026-03-17T09:41:12Z autoscaler: retrying attach (attempt 5) backoff=8s```
Emily (eng-runtime): Noted. Our routing policy still tries to spin up n1-standard + A100s per job. We have smaller-ram GPU SKUs in eu-west1. Can we route new requests temporarily to eu-west1?
Arjun (SRE): Yes — immediate mitigation plan: (1) enable fallback routing to eu-west1 (2) drain non-critical batch jobs in europe-north2 (3) enable quantized model variant on hosted tier to reduce GPU footprint (4) open support case with Azure for quota bump.
Maya (oncall): Ben/Sofia please pull customer-impact numbers. which customers seeing errors?
Ben (Support): Support dashboard: ~4% of inference requests in eu-north2 returning 503s over last 6m. Two customers reported timeouts on production endpoints: acme-payments and flint-analytics. Both premium. Ticket IDs: #13244, #13245.
Sofia (Customer Success): I’ll draft a short customer note: "We’re experiencing limited capacity in europe-north2 causing delayed/failed requests. Traffic is being rerouted and we expect normalization in 15–30 minutes. We will update as we confirm recovery."
Arjun (SRE): Executing steps now: running routing toggle.
DeployBot: user emily triggered route-toggle to eu-west1 for model: rwd/llm-1b-std with reason: quota-fallback. jobId=deploy-1748123470
Arjun (SRE): Command run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/internal/route-toggle -d '{"from":"europe-north2","to":"eu-west1","models":["rwd/llm-1b-std"]}'`
Arjun (SRE): Also reducing batch size to 1 for streaming endpoints in impacted region to lower attach rate.
Emily (eng-runtime): enabling quantized variant: `PATCH /v1/models/rwd/llm-1b-std/config {"variant":"int8-faster"}` — will take ~45s to warm.
Maya (oncall): Azure support case opened: INC-99228 (quota request submitted for europe-north2 GPUs). ETA: support response 30–60m. Logged with billing/quotas team.
Ben (Support): Customer comm posted to ACME and Flint tickets. Both acknowledged, asking for ETA on root cause. Sofia is on the replies.
Arjun (SRE): Monitoring: queue depth metric (worker.queue.length) peaked at 12k, now trending down to 3.1k after route toggle. autoscaler attach fail rate decreased but still some 403s.
Maya (oncall): Good. continuing monitoring. If attach retries continue after 15m we’ll spin up CPU inference fallback for non-latency-sensitive endpoints.
Emily (eng-runtime): Started CPU fallback for background batch jobs: `jobs.scale --region=europe-north2 --pool=cpu-fallback --tag=batch-nonlive`
Arjun (SRE): Quick note: we also identified several warm-pool instances reserved under old project constraints consuming quota. Scheduling eviction: `az vm delete --ids <warm-instance-ids>` after graceful drain.
Maya (oncall): Any customer impact outside europe-north2? metrics show eu-west1 and us regions normal.
Ben (Support): No new reports. ACME on call says their payments flow is degraded for 8m but they’re using fallback now.
Sofia (Customer Success): Draft customer update sent to ops for approval: "We routed traffic to neighboring region and enabled lower-footprint variants — we’ll share full incident summary after root-cause analysis."
Arjun (SRE): Azure support replied: case INC-99228 — preliminary comment: "quota limits hit due to rapid instance attach; we see no org-wide hard cap but soft provisioning delay. We’ve escalated to platform quota team."
Maya (oncall): Status: partial mitigation achieved. Queue down, error rate reduced from 4%->0.7%. Continuing to monitor for 60m. If stable, will close pager and track as Sev2 with postmortem.
Ben (Support): ACME confirm degraded but acceptable. They asked for timeline; I gave estimate 1–2 hours for full normalization.
Arjun (SRE): Follow-ups: (A) Runbook book items: add proactive warm-pool eviction step (B) Add automated fallback routing when attach 403s exceed 5% for 5m (C) Check quota telemetry to detect soft provisioning delays.
Maya (oncall): Assigning postmortem to Arjun + Emily. Owner: Arjun. Due in 72h.
Maya (oncall): Closing bridge to paging mode at 09:50Z — will reopen if regressions. Final note: created internal bug #BI-809 for warm-pool quota accounting.
Arjun (SRE): Thanks — will follow up with a timeline and remediation plan.
Sofia (Customer Success): Thanks team. Posting final customer update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident 1748123456 status: mitigated — monitoring.
Maya (oncall): +1 — handing off to oncall-secondary for overnight watch. Good job everyone.
